turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Hello, come in and have a seat. How old are you?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: I'm divorced. It's been about ten years.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: I'm sorry to ask this, but can you tell me about your health?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: I hurt my back badly in 2022, and I can't walk more than half a block without stopping.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: That sounds really hard. Did you have to stop working because of it?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Yes, I stopped working in 2022 because of the injury. I used to drive a delivery truck.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: What income do you have right now?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Right now I don't have any income, zero, I'm not earning anything.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Have you applied for the Disability Tax Credit before?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: I've never applied for it. I didn't know what it was.

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: No, I lost my benefits when I stopped working. No private dental.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: When did you last file your taxes?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: I filed my 2025 return back in the spring. It was a short one since I had no income.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Before we finish, is there anything you'd like to correct from earlier?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Yes, going back to my back, sorry, it was 2021, not 2022.
